revenue.source: HD FY2023 Q4 earnings release (8-K Feb 2024); FY2024 10-K acc. 0000354950-25-000085; FY2025 10-K/Q4 release (8-K Ex.99.1, FYE Feb 1, 2026). Net sales, $M.

operating_income.source: Same filings; GAAP operating income, $M (FY2025 per Q4 FY2025 release).

d_and_a.source: Cash-flow statement total D&A: FY2023 3,247 (Q4 FY23 release); FY2024 3,336 + 425 intangible amortization; FY2025 3,514 + 607 intangible amortization (Q4 FY25 release). Includes D&A in COGS; income-statement-only D&A line is 2,673/3,034/3,273.

capex.source: Cash-flow statement capital expenditures, FY2023 10-K / FY2025 Q4 release, $M.

revenue_growth.source: Analyst assumption: FY2025 growth was 3.2% (164,683 vs 159,514) with comps +0.3%; FY2026 helped by full year of GMS acquisition and housing recovery; fades to 3.0% toward nominal GDP. Not company guidance.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: held at FY2025 GAAP margin 12.7% (20,890/164,683); FY2026 guidance adjusted operating margin ~12.8-13.0% (Q4 FY25 release) but GAAP includes acquired-intangible amortization, so kept flat.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: HD effective tax rate has run ~24-25% in recent years; no statutory change assumed.

da_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 total cash-flow D&A 4,121/164,683 = 2.50%; held flat (elevated by GMS intangibles).

capex_pct_revenue.source: Company guidance: capex ~2.5% of sales for FY2026 (Q4 FY25 release); FY2025 actual 2.23%; held at guidance.

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM with beta ~1.0, risk-free ~4.3%, ERP ~5%, cost of equity ~9.3%, after-tax cost of debt ~4%, debt ~10-15% of capital -> ~8.0%. Not sourced from a data provider.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal growth below WACC, in line with inflation plus modest real growth.

net_debt.source: Balance sheet at Feb 1, 2026 (Q4 FY25 release): short-term debt 4,464 + current installments LT debt 4,967 + LT debt excl. current 46,341 = 55,772, less cash 1,389 = 54,383. No short-term investments reported. Debt carrying amount may include finance leases (not separable here); operating leases excluded.

diluted_shares.source: Diluted weighted average common shares FY2025 = 995 million (Q4 FY25 release, Feb 1, 2026), same scale as $ millions.
